description: This file defines the InboxMainActivity class, an Android activity responsible for managing the inbox view in a wearables notification app. It includes code to cancel notifications when the activity is created and serves as a template for handling email data and notification display.

classes.name: InboxMainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class handling the inbox view in a wearable notifications app. It cancels ongoing notifications upon creation and provides a placeholder for displaying email content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI layout, and cancels a specific notification to ensure the notification state is reset when the activity is opened.
